If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up, and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with…

translations.web: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
translations.bsb: The waters of the Nile will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and empty.
translations.kjv: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
translations.asv: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and become dry.
